author: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
description:
Some proteins can turn into zombies, infect others, and wreak havoc in your brain. These misfolded invaders are callde Prions and might hold the key to Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and the future of neuroscience.
